description: This Java source file defines the EncounterTypeLockedException class, a custom exception used in the OpenMRS API to handle cases where encounter types are locked and modifications are attempted.

classes.name: EncounterTypeLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that indicates encounter types are locked and cannot be edited.

methods.name: EncounterTypeLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor providing a standard message indicating that encounter types are locked and editing is not allowed.

methods.name: EncounterTypeLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message about why the encounter types are locked.

methods.name: EncounterTypeLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that allows chaining a cause exception along with a custom message.

methods.name: EncounterTypeLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor to wrap another exception without a custom message.
